units.rawText: "You're nothing but a stinky cat!" That's what they always called me in the real world. Back then, yours truly couldn't stand it and found all sorts of ways to get back at them.

units.rawText: But since coming to the Oasis, it seems yours truly has become much more open-minded. I hardly fuss over such trivial things anymore.

units.rawText: Serious and diligent at work, properly relaxed after hours. Taking off the mask I've worn for so long and showing my most dangerous, most daring side to someone close... Isn't that nice too?

units.rawText: Doll or human, everyone gets tired sometimes. Like you said, Professor, when you're tired, you should rest. Inola has found a safe harbor to rest in now, so she doesn't have to push herself to keep sailing anymore...
